# === Builtins ===

--8<-- [start:in_real_1_and_in_real_3]
in_real(X)                    % X ∈ [-∞, +∞]
in_real(X, 0.0, 1.0)          % X ∈ [0, 1]
in_real([X, Y, Z], -5.0, 5.0)   % all three ∈ [-5, 5]
--8<-- [end:in_real_1_and_in_real_3]

--8<-- [start:label_real_1_and_label_real_2]
label_real([X, Y])            % bisect to IEEE float precision
label_real([X, Y], 1.0e-9)   % bisect until width ≤ 1e-9
--8<-- [end:label_real_1_and_label_real_2]


# === Constraint examples ===

--8<-- [start:linear_constraints]
# Two-variable linear system: 2x + 3y = 12, x - y = 1
linear_system(X, Y) <- (
    in_real(X, -100.0, 100.0),
    in_real(Y, -100.0, 100.0),
    2.0 * X + 3.0 * Y == 12.0,
    X - Y == 1.0,
    label_real([X, Y], 1.0e-9)
)
# → X ≈ 3.0, Y ≈ 2.0
--8<-- [end:linear_constraints]

--8<-- [start:non_linear_constraints]
# Unit circle (first quadrant)
unit_circle(X, Y) <- (
    in_real(X, 0.0, 1.0),
    in_real(Y, 0.0, 1.0),
    X * X + Y * Y == 1.0,
    label_real([X, Y], 1.0e-9)
)
# → X ≈ 0.7071..., Y ≈ 0.7071...  (and other points)
--8<-- [end:non_linear_constraints]

--8<-- [start:non_linear_constraints_ex2]
# Square root: find x where x^2 = 2
sqrt2(X) <- (
    in_real(X, 0.0, 2.0),
    X * X == 2.0,
    label_real([X], 1.0e-12)
)
# → X ≈ 1.4142135623730951
--8<-- [end:non_linear_constraints_ex2]

--8<-- [start:mixed_fd_and_real]
# Worker schedule: integer hours, real cost
task(HOURS, COST) <- (
    in_domain(HOURS, 1, 8),         % integer hours (CLP(ℤ))
    in_real(COST, 10.0, 100.0),     % real cost (CLP(ℝ))
    COST >= HOURS * 12.5,          % mixes FD + real
    HOURS <= 6,
    label([HOURS]),
    label_real([COST], 1.0e-6)
)
--8<-- [end:mixed_fd_and_real]

--8<-- [start:mixed_fd_and_real_ex2]
# Start with a real constraint, then restrict to integers
mixed(X) <- (
    in_real(X, 0.0, 100.0),
    X * X <= 50.0,
    in_domain(X, 1, 10),    % adds FD domain alongside real
    label([X])
)
--8<-- [end:mixed_fd_and_real_ex2]

--8<-- [start:float_literals_trigger_clp]
# The float literal 25.0 puts the equation in CLP(ℝ); in_real only sets the bounds
pythagorean_real(X, Y) <- (
    in_real(X, 0.0, 10.0),
    in_real(Y, 0.0, 10.0),
    X * X + Y * Y == 25.0,
    label_real([X, Y], 1.0e-6)
)
--8<-- [end:float_literals_trigger_clp]
